SysDataModelXML.SQLScript: #LINKSCRIPTGET@LINK01: DECLARE @SDHNUM VARCHAR(30)='{1}'; SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 ITMREF_0 FROM XWSPTH WHERE SDHNUM_0=@SDHNUM AND RPFLG_0<>3 AND POHNUM_0='' ) THEN N'LINKPREVENT:lang:{zh:订单匹配不完整,en:Order matching incomplete,de:Auftragszuordnung unvollständig}' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 ITMREF_0 FROM XWSPTH WHERE SDHNUM_0=@SDHNUM AND RPFLG_0<>3 AND LOC_0='' ) THEN N'LINKPREVENT:lang:{zh:库位不完整,en:Location incomplete,de:Lagerplatz unvollständig}' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 XWS.ITMREF_0 FROM XWSPTH XWS INNER JOIN ITMMASTER ITM ON XWS.ITMREF_0=ITM.ITMREF_0 INNER JOIN ITMFACILIT ITF ON XWS.ITMREF_0=ITF.ITMREF_0 AND XWS.PRHFCY_0=ITF.STOFCY_0 WHERE XWS.SDHNUM_0=@SDHNUM AND XWS.RPFLG_0<>3 AND ITM.LOTMGTCOD_0=3 AND ITF.YLOTCAN_0<>2 ) THEN N'LINKPREVENT:lang:{zh:批次不完整,en:Batch incomplete,de:Charge unvollständig}' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 ITMREF_0 FROM XWSPTH WHERE SDHNUM_0=@SDHNUM AND RPFLG_0<>3 AND STAT_0=2) THEN N'LINKPREVENT:lang:{zh:提交生成ERP收货单中,en:Submitting to generate ERP receipt,de:ERP-Wareneingang wird erstellt}' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 ITMREF_0 FROM XWSPTH WHERE SDHNUM_0=@SDHNUM AND RPFLG_0=3) THEN N'LINKPREVENT:lang:{zh:该发货单已生成收货记录,en:This delivery note already has receipt record,de:Lieferschein hat bereits Wareneingang}' ELSE N'LINKCONFIRM:lang:{zh:确认整单提交吗？,en:Confirm submit entire order?,de:Kompletten Auftrag übermitteln?}' END #
SysDataModelXML.CallFunction: CALLFUNCTION~X3WEB~RUN~XWSTTLINKU~ <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> <PARAM> <FLD NAM="XWS_MACHINEID">#LOGIN_ID#</FLD> <FLD NAM="XWS_USERID">#LOGIN_USER#</FLD> <FLD NAM="XWS_TRSTYP">6</FLD> <FLD NAM="XWS_PK"></FLD> <FLD NAM="XWS_BATCHID">#LINKID_ACTION#</FLD> </PARAM> ~{"codeLang":"#LINKFUNC.GETLANX3#"}
